notes.title: Marty's Funducational Tour! Release Date
notes.notes: [p]Howdy All,[/p][p][/p][p]Big news! Marty's Funducational Tour! is ready for release and will be releasing on [b]July 25th[/b]. Wahooo, Yippee. Me (and Marty) are very excited to show you the result of all our hard work for the last few months. Don't forget to tell your friends, your mom, your friends mom's, and your grandma about it.[/p][p][/p][p]Also I have updated the Demo and made two more buildings available (House and Funeral Home), so you can check out those buildings if you like.[/p][p][/p][p]Last of all I would like to thank everyone who supported this game, wishlisted it, or maybe mentioned it in passing to someone. Your support makes me very happy. [/p][p][/p][p][i]If two roads met in the wood and you took the road less traveled, that would damage your footwear more and could cause blisters. So be careful meeting roads in the wood.[/i][/p][p][b]-[/b]Marty[/p]

notes.title: Demo Release for Marty's Funducational Tour!
notes.notes:
Howdy All,

Install the Demo and you can finally take the tour of the small town that Marty has created for your entertainment.

Explore the banal world of rural America as Marty entertains you with various facts and knowledge about human culture! Help him fix up his town in order to remove any inconsistencies.


*Feel free to leave feedback in the discord or directly on the steampage
